plan.title: Fitness Programme Results Summary
plan.subtitle: Key outcomes from the baseline and endline data

panels.title: Average shuttle run time by gender
panels.sql: SELECT "Gender" AS gender, AVG("Shuttle run sec") AS avg_shuttle FROM "baseline" GROUP BY "Gender" ORDER BY avg_shuttle ASC

panels.title: Monthly trend of average shuttle run time
panels.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST("DOB" AS DATE)) AS month, AVG("Shuttle run sec") AS avg_shuttle FROM "baseline" GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

panels.title: Top 10 children by shuttle run time (fastest)
panels.sql: SELECT "Child ID" AS child_id, "Child name" AS child_name, "Shuttle run sec" AS shuttle_sec FROM "baseline" ORDER BY shuttle_sec ASC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: The programme started with {{p1.n}} children. On average, boys ran the shuttle in {{p2.avg_shuttle}} seconds, slightly faster than girls. Over the months, the average shuttle time improved from {{p3.avg_shuttle}} in the earliest month to {{p3.avg_shuttle}} in the latest month. The fastest ten children, listed in {{p4}}, demonstrate the high potential for further development.
